Guest path: /search?q=… -> a /products/ link (pressing Enter on the link worked where a click was covered) -> Add to bag (button[name="add"]; no size prompt on the item tried) -> /cart -> button[name="checkout"] -> Shopify one-page checkout. No account prompt.
